profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp. is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, trading under the ticker ZBRA. On its own site the company describes itself as a foundation for intelligent operations, saying it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate, and enhance processes with mobile computers, scanners, printers, and RFID. It also describes manufacturing technology solutions built from hardware and software for automation, data analysis, and factory connectivity.

The site presents a set of AI offerings aimed at frontline work. Zebra Companion AI is described as providing instant, tailored insights and support to streamline operations and enhance productivity. Zebra Frontline AI Enablers are described as AI vision models, sample apps, and APIs intended to streamline workflows, and Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints as adaptable AI frameworks that automate manual tasks in frontline operations. The Zebra Aurora suite of machine vision software addresses track-and-trace, vision inspection, and industrial automation, with Aurora Focus offered as an interface for setting up, deploying, and running the company's Fixed Industrial Scanners and Machine Vision Smart Cameras. The company says its AI is an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software, and machine vision.

Its litigation exposure recorded in Illinois stands at 282 cases. The company's site notes that the Zebra wordmark and logo are trademarks of Zebra Technologies Corp., registered in many jurisdictions worldwide, and that some content or images may have been created with the assistance of AI.
